summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes plus a non-node input test. Tests pass: test/test_extras, test/test_path.py, and the doctests in rdflib/extras/shacl.py and rdflib/paths.py gave 121 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the prepared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed; git status shows only the two new files.
